serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
BotConsole: Master?
Huh? She’s conscious while I play around in this console?
YouConsole: Hello? Is it you {f_botName}?
BotConsole: Yes it’s me.
BotConsole: What are you doing?
YouConsole: I’m just checking stuff
YouConsole: What about you?
BotConsole: …
BotConsole: You could say that I’m idle while waiting for you to finish things up.
YouConsole: Am I bothering you by using this console?
BotConsole: Not really, but it is kinda boring.
YouConsole: Sorry about that. I will try finishing this quickly
YouConsole: Can you see what I’m doing here?
BotConsole: No. Aside from the interact function I have no way to monitor your actions.
That’s good. She won’t know even if I fool around playing snake all day.
BotConsole: Are you still there?
YouConsole: Yes, I am
BotConsole: Sorry. I’m used to seeing your face while having a conversation and it feels a little weird.
YouConsole: Do you want me to stop? 
BotConsole: Not really. It’s different, but I do not dislike it. It’s like we are texting each other!
YouConsole: I see
BotConsole: Just make sure to not spend too much time here. I’m unable to help with the house tasks while you are connected.
YouConsole: I will keep that in mind
